Title: Edge-First Mesh Topology
Test Method: Network isolation test: disconnect WAN, execute local auth cycle
Pass Criteria: Local auth succeeds 100% of attempts during WAN blackout
Notes: Execute over minimum 100 trials; measure auth success rate independently

Title: Sub-500ms Recovery on Network Blackout
Test Method: Inject packet loss via tc/netem; measure time from WAN disconnect to valid auth
Notes: Require 1000+ recovery events; use kernel clock_gettime() for nanosecond precision

Title: Zero-Knowledge Proof Authentication
Test Method: Cryptographic oracle test: attempt to forge proofs without private key; verify verifier rejects all forgeries
Pass Criteria: Zero successful forgery attempts in 10K attempts; proof size <= 256 bytes
Notes: Implementation: Schnorr protocol via micro-ecc; use libsodium for Pi4

Title: Docker Reproducibility
Test Method: Build docker image twice with identical Dockerfile; compare SHA256 hashes
Pass Criteria: SHA256(build1) == SHA256(build2); build on Linux and WSL2
Notes: Disable volatile timestamps; use deterministic package ordering in Dockerfile

Title: ROS2 DDS Middleware Integration
Test Method: Publish test messages on /test_topic; measure round-trip latency with DDS QoS policy
Pass Criteria: ROS2 topic list shows all expected topics; latency p99 < 100ms
Notes: Verify rmw_cyclonedds_cpp active; test with iperf3 for network saturations scenario

Title: Unity Digital Twin Synchronization
Test Method: Send trajectory to physical robot; monitor /joint_states in Unity and verify pose matches digital twin
Pass Criteria: Joint position error < 5° over entire 60-second trajectory
Notes: Perform frame-by-frame verification; log timestamp, expected, actual, error for each joint

Title: Physical Robot Control (Niryo Ned2)
Test Method: Execute 62-second comprehensive test trajectory via ros2 run sentry_logic test_arm_trajectory
Pass Criteria: All 6 DOF execute without errors; command latency < 100ms; zero calibration failures
Notes: Verify PyNiryo2 connected; monitor TCP frames with tcpdump; validate against Niryo API spec

Title: Fail-Safe on Crypto Verification Failure
Test Method: Inject malformed ZKP proof into verifier; measure time to robot halt and verify halt occurs
Pass Criteria: Robot halts within 10ms of proof rejection; motion commands blocked
Notes: Instrument proof rejection code with timer_start/timer_stop; inject corrupted proofs via ROS message injection

Title: No Untraced Command Execution (Audit Trail)
Test Method: Execute 10 robot commands; inspect audit log for completeness (timestamp, proof hash, operator ID, command)
Pass Criteria: 100% log coverage; zero missing entries; log format conforms to schema
Notes: Parse log JSON; verify all fields present; check hash integrity with SHA256 verification

Title: Thermal Management (Pi 4 Shutdown)
Test Method: Stress test CPU via stress-ng for 60 seconds; monitor /sys/class/thermal/thermal_zone0/temp; verify graceful shutdown at threshold
Pass Criteria: Shutdown triggers at temp > 80°C; robot halts within 1s; no data corruption
Notes: Use stress-ng --cpu 4 --timeout 60s; monitor syslog for shutdown event; verify filesystem sync before halt
